Crawls subdomains when allow_subdomains is enabled

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "crawlberg.h"

int main(void) {
    CBERGAlefHandle config_handle = cberg_crawl_config_from_json("{\"allow_subdomains\":true,\"max_depth\":1,\"respect_robots_txt\":false,\"stay_on_domain\":true}");
    CBERGAlefHandle engine = cberg_create_engine(config_handle);
    cberg_crawl_config_free(config_handle);
    char url[2048];
    snprintf(url, sizeof(url), "%s", "https://example.com");
    CBERGAlefHandle result = cberg_crawl(engine, url);
    if (result != 0) cberg_crawl_result_free(result);
    cberg_crawl_engine_handle_free(engine);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
